title: Shorter paths for the generation API
summary:
Shorter API paths and Amazon Nova Micro joined the model lineup, alongside a GPT Image editing fix and two community project listings.

Added a `gen.pollinations.ai` gateway with shorter image, text and OpenAI-compatible paths, plus a `/models` shortcut. The API documentation now uses the new paths and covers text-generation query parameters.

Added Amazon Nova Micro as `nova-micro`, with `amazon-nova-micro` and `nova` aliases. It supports text conversations and tools.

Fixed GPT Image img2img requests to use `gpt-image-1-mini` with the image-editing endpoint, rather than switching models. This PR also included gateway and documentation changes covered above.

daily.title: Shorter generation API paths
daily.text: Use `gen.pollinations.ai` paths such as `/image/*`, `/text/*` and `/v1/*`, with `/models` as a shortcut to the text model list. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Amazon Nova Micro added
daily.text: Use `nova-micro` for text conversations and tool calls; `amazon-nova-micro` and `nova` are aliases. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nova-micro).
